mapper.select: /* DailyContractMapper.selectActiveContract */ SELECT SITE_CD AS siteCd , CONTRACT_VER AS contractVer , CONTRACT_NM AS contractNm , FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , DATE_FORMAT(INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_DAILY_CONTRACT WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1

/* DailyContractMapper.selectContractVersionList */ SELECT C.CONTRACT_VER AS contractVer , C.CONTRACT_NM AS contractNm , C.USE_YN AS useYn , C.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , IFNULL(U.USER_NM, C.INSERT_NO) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(C.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_DAILY_CONTRACT C LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND C.INSERT_NO = U.USER_CD ) WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} ORDER BY C.CONTRACT_VER DESC LIMIT #{limitCnt}

/* DailyContractMapper.selectLatestSignForVer */ SELECT SIGN_ID AS signId , SITE_CD AS siteCd , USER_CD AS userCd , USER_NM_SNAPSHOT AS userNmSnapshot , CONTRACT_VER AS contractVer , REQ_ID AS reqId , MERGED_FILE_MGMT_CD AS mergedFileMgmtCd , MERGED_SHA256 AS mergedSha256 , FIRST_WORK_DATE AS firstWorkDate , DATE_FORMAT(SIGN_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS signDtime FROM TB_DAILY_CONTRACT_SIGN WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd} AND CONTRACT_VER = #{contractVer} ORDER BY SIGN_DTIME DESC LIMIT 1

/* DailyContractMapper.selectMySignLatest */ SELECT SIGN_ID AS signId , SITE_CD AS siteCd , USER_CD AS userCd , USER_NM_SNAPSHOT AS userNmSnapshot , CONTRACT_VER AS contractVer , REQ_ID AS reqId , MERGED_FILE_MGMT_CD AS mergedFileMgmtCd , MERGED_SHA256 AS mergedSha256 , FIRST_WORK_DATE AS firstWorkDate , DATE_FORMAT(SIGN_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS signDtime FROM TB_DAILY_CONTRACT_SIGN WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd} ORDER BY SIGN_DTIME DESC LIMIT 1

/* DailyContractMapper.selectSignMetaById */ SELECT SIGN_ID AS signId , SITE_CD AS siteCd , USER_CD AS userCd , USER_NM_SNAPSHOT AS userNmSnapshot , CONTRACT_VER AS contractVer , REQ_ID AS reqId , MERGED_FILE_MGMT_CD AS mergedFileMgmtCd , MERGED_SHA256 AS mergedSha256 , FIRST_WORK_DATE AS firstWorkDate , DATE_FORMAT(SIGN_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS signDtime FROM TB_DAILY_CONTRACT_SIGN WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND SIGN_ID = #{signId}
